{{Top|leg}}
A '''targeted barrage''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] military tactic used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] that concentrated [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire on the weak points of enemy ships and was often the easiest way to bring down [[Carrier/Legends|carriers]].<ref name="SWPM">{{PocketModel|set=Base Set|cardname=Targeted Barrage|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/card069.jpg}}</ref>
